questions.question: Describe your experience using QuickBooks to support accounting functions, including accounts payable, check preparation, and petty cash administration at Surescripts.
What experience do you have with invoicing and contract-related processes, and how have you ensured invoices reflect agreed-upon client terms?
This role requires interpreting complex contracts and statements of work to establish billing rules. How have you handled contract additions, edits, and negotiations in your account-management roles?
Walk me through how you created and managed project P&Ls for Production. What inputs did you use, and how did you monitor performance against budget?
You have standardized processes for contracts, invoicing, and client transitions at Graphiq. What was the process problem, what changes did you implement, and what was the outcome?
Describe how you analyzed monthly revenue reports at Graphiq to identify growth opportunities. What metrics did you examine, and how did your findings affect actions taken?

This position involves monthly balance-sheet reconciliations and variance investigation. Tell us about a time you investigated a discrepancy in a revenue report, account, budget, or project financials.
How would you approach translating the commercial terms of a software or services contract into a billing schedule and revenue-recognition approach under ASC 606?

The role supports a fast-paced SaaS close process and requires accurate, deadline-driven work. How have you organized competing client, revenue, reporting, and project deadlines across a large account portfolio?
Give an example of a time you used Salesforce, Excel, QuickBooks, or another system to improve the accuracy, visibility, or efficiency of a financial or operational process.
